request_payload.title: Structure of the SHOC2-MRAS-PP1C complex provides insights into RAF activation and Noonan syndrome.

mentions.mention: dephosphorylating a specific phosphoserine on RAF kinases
mentions.sentence: SHOC2 forms a heterotrimeric complex with MRAS and PP1C that is essential for regulating RAF and MAPK-pathway activation by dephosphorylating a specific phosphoserine on RAF kinases.
